changelog.title: Halloween, Space & Sound
items: Added a Halloween event (October 1 - November 1): 8 Halloween achievements, the Haunted Harvest theme for unlocking all of them (yours forever once earned), a dashboard banner with a countdown and a theme preview, and a Halloween section in Achievements - all only available until November 1
New sound design: 13 distinct sounds in three packs - Glass (new), Classic and Arcade - with a Preview button in Advanced Settings
Added size on disk to game cards, sorting by size, a Disk Usage dashboard widget and a Free Up Space tool that finds big games you have not played in months
Added drag and drop for programs and shortcuts, plus Import from Start menu, to add non-Steam games
Added Undo for hiding games, removing games from collections, deleting collections and removing non-Steam games
Added arrow-key navigation in the library, and rebindable global hotkeys
Added Quiet Hours, a switch to quit instead of hiding to the tray, automatic update checks you can turn off, and Skip this version
Added quick links (Steam Store, SteamDB, PCGamingWiki, HowLongToBeat) to the game right-click menu
Fixed "Quit SteamLite" in the command palette only hiding the window

Halloween event (October 1 - November 1, every year): 8 spooky achievements that count play during the event (Trick or Treat, Witching Hour, Night Stalker, Vampire Hours, Tangled Web, Haunted Marathon, Graveyard Shift and Spooky Season Survivor), a dashboard banner with a countdown and a Preview theme button, and the Haunted Harvest theme for unlocking all of them (yours forever once earned) - all only available until November 1

New sound design: 13 distinct sounds (clicks, windows opening and closing, switches, notifications, success and error, achievements, streaks, game launch and stop, favorites) in three packs - Glass (new), Classic (the original) and Arcade

Disk tools: size on disk on every installed game, sort by size, a Disk Usage dashboard widget with free space per drive, and Free Up Space, which lists the biggest games and flags ones you have not touched in months
Drag a program (.exe) or shortcut (.lnk) onto the window to add it as a non-Steam game, or import several from your Start menu
Undo button after hiding games, removing a game from a collection, deleting a collection or removing a non-Steam game
Move around the library with the arrow keys (Enter opens, F favorites), and change the Quick Launch, Command Palette and Stop Game hotkeys
Quiet Hours for notification sounds and friend pop-ups, a switch to quit when you close the window, automatic update checks you can turn off, and Skip this version
Right-click a game to open its Steam Store page, SteamDB, PCGamingWiki or HowLongToBeat
Sounds that happen close together are no longer dropped, and toasts sound like what they say
Dropping a file onto the window no longer tries to open it inside SteamLite
"Quit SteamLite" in the command palette now really quits instead of hiding the window to the tray

news.title: SteamLite 8.4.0 Released - Halloween Event
news.content: SteamLite 8.4.0 brings the Halloween event (October 1 - November 1): 8 spooky achievements, a new Haunted Harvest theme to unlock, and a countdown banner on your dashboard - all only available until November 1. It is also a big quality-of-life update: a brand new sound design with three sound packs, disk usage tools that show how much space each game takes and help you free some up, drag and drop and Start menu import for non-Steam games, Undo buttons, arrow-key navigation in the library, rebindable global hotkeys, Quiet Hours, a switch to quit instead of hiding to the tray, Skip this version for updates, and quick links to SteamDB, PCGamingWiki and more.

news.title: SteamLite 8.3.6 Released
news.content: SteamLite 8.3.6 fixes updates not being detected on some PCs (the app now waits until its window is ready, retries, and re-checks every 4 hours), and fixes missing cover images on many newer games by finding their art through Steam's store - a long-standing issue that goes back to at least v1.3.0. If updates have stopped being detected on your PC, install 8.3.6 manually once - updates from here on will work in-app.

news.title: SteamLite 8.3.5 Released
news.content: SteamLite 8.3.5 adds a first-time setup you can replay from the command palette, Compare with a friend (see how your libraries and playtime stack up), a Game News widget on the dashboard, achievement search with a new slide-and-fade animation, Appearance settings (card styles including a new Cover only view, card size and spacing, fonts and UI scale), and Potato Mode for older PCs and integrated graphics.

news.title: SteamLite 8.3.0 Released
news.content: SteamLite 8.3.0 is a big profile, friends and library update: banner gradients, an Edit Profile window with a tagline, game showcase, avatar frames and badges; pinned friends with nicknames, notes, search and sorting; friend notifications with profile pictures; smart collections, multi-select and a smarter Play Next; a weekly playtime goal and per-game session history; plus settings backup, start-with-Windows and keyboard shortcuts.

news.title: SteamLite 8.2.2 Released
news.content: SteamLite 8.2.2 fixes Restart & Install closing the app without ever opening the installer, removes the old small update banner so the new updater page is the only update UI, and makes the installer close any leftover SteamLite process before upgrading. If you're on 8.2.0 or 8.2.1, install 8.2.2 manually once - updates from 8.2.2 onward will work in-app.

news.title: SteamLite 8.2.1 Released
news.content: SteamLite 8.2.1 fixes the update notification appearing twice when an update is found (the updater page and the small banner showed at the same time).

news.title: SteamLite 8.2.0 Released
news.content: SteamLite 8.2.0 lets you customise your own profile banner with any image or GIF (with blur and dim controls), brings a redesigned What's New screen with categorized changes and a release history, and fixes the in-app updater so the installer opens properly after SteamLite closes.

news.title: SteamLite 8.1.4 Released
news.content: SteamLite 8.1.4 fixes the Friends in Common list popping in with no transition on a friend's profile, and replaces the installer with a proper NSIS setup wizard (app icon, all-users/just-me choice, upgrade detection, optional launch on finish).

news.title: SteamLite 8.1.3 Bug Fix & Security Release
news.content: SteamLite 8.1.3 is a focused bug-fix release: it corrects a streak-recovery date bug, fixes the Max Common Friends setting not saving, cleans up two event-listener memory leaks (game modal and UI Editor dragging), stops a duplicate achievement-unlock toast, hardens news rendering against malformed content, fixes Dashboard layout edits and theme background colors not persisting, fixes the Play/Stop button never detecting a running game on PCs without wmic.exe, cleans up the game modal's ⋯ menu (scrollbar flash, redundant News entry), restores proper fade in/out for the game modal and Settings menu, and optimises animations. The app also drops its old codename, and the installer now offers real options (install location, shortcuts, launch-after-install).

news.title: SteamLite 8.1.2 Released
news.content: SteamLite 8.1.2 brings 5 new themes, 5 new achievements, and fixes for dashboard widget persistence and profile banner layout. Enjoy the new visual options and continue your achievement journey!

news.title: SteamLite 8.1.1 Bug Fix Release
news.content: SteamLite 8.1.1 focuses on fixing reported issues and adding quality-of-life improvements including achievement image display, UI fixes, dashboard customization, and modernized What's New screen.
